name: bakery
description: Бэкенд на Go для пекарни: Telegram-бот, HTTP API и worker, организованные по clean architecture (cmd/bot, cmd/worker; сервисы order/auth/admin/department/monitor/sync/techcard; inbound bot/api, outbound db/iiko). Frontend — Telegram mini-app на React 19 + Vite + Tailwind v4. Хранилище Postgres через sqlc, очереди RabbitMQ, интеграция с ERP iiko. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
